**Direct Communication:** Approach the neighbors respectfully to discuss concerns (e.g., *"We’ve noticed some noise—is everything okay?"*). - **Neutral Warnings:** If safety is a concern, a factual note (e.g., *"Please be mindful of noise after 10 PM"*) is more constructive. -
